{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check cross-tabulation: channel vs segment
# We see email is heavily skewed toward loyal customers (131 out of 326)
# paid_search has more new and returning customers
# So we must stratify by segment to avoid confounding

# Compute conversion rate by channel, stratified by segment
# We compute conversion rate within each segment, then combine

# Create a pivot table for conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print('Conversion rate by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel (unadjusted)
overall_conv_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print('\nOverall conversion rate by channel (unadjusted):')
print(overall_conv_channel)

# Compute adjusted conversion rate: average of segment-specific rates
# Weighted by segment size in each channel

# For each channel, compute weighted average of conversion rates
# by segment, weighted by segment size in that channel

# Get segment counts per channel
segment_counts = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().reset_index(name='count')

# Merge with conversion rates
segment_counts = segment_counts.merge(conversion_by_channel_segment, on=['channel', 'customer_segment'])

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel
segment_counts['weighted_conv'] = segment_counts['count'] * segment_counts['converted']

# Sum by channel
weighted_conv_by_channel = segment_counts.groupby('channel')['weighted_conv'].sum() / segment_counts.groupby('channel')['count'].sum()

print('\nAdjusted conversion rate by channel (stratified by segment):')
print(weighted_conv_by_channel)

# Compute the ratio of email to paid_search conversion rate
ratio = weighted_conv_by_channel['email'] / weighted_conv_by_channel['paid_search']
print(f'\nRatio of email to paid_search conversion rate (adjusted): {ratio:.4f}')"}
